alert.title: Product listing search suddenly slow after the index mapping migration
alert.symptoms: p95 latency for /search/products went from about 110ms to 2.1s right after the catalog mapping migration finished; category pages time out intermittently.
alert.error_message: slow_query on catalog index: filter falling back to script_score
alert.log_snippet:
2026-09-28T09:20:00Z WARN search-api [query-executor] slow_query index=catalog-v3 duration_ms=2144 filter=brand_id:null fallback=script_score
p95_latency=2100ms error_rate=1.5%

response.root_cause: Recent catalog index mapping migration introduced incompatible field types causing filters to fall back to script_score, leading to slow queries.
response.blast_radius: Search API product and category endpoints experience high latency and timeouts, affecting all users performing product searches.
first_actions: Review the mapping changes applied during the migration and identify fields causing script_score fallback
Check Elasticsearch slow query logs and profile the /search/products query to pinpoint the bottleneck
If needed, revert the mapping or reindex the catalog index with correct field types and update queries accordingly
